verdictBasis: QE-R7B1-04 is closed correctly: on the frozen bytes the clinical route that the review's own handler screen takes is the decision before R7-A's late-evidence question, the factual re-plan's question, the block-choice questions and the return's report-identity question; it is the handler's own route; late evidence is recorded and still asked about later; every review without a clinical signal decides exactly as on R7B1-FREEZE-2; no R7-B.1 closure regresses; no new route bypasses the clinical screen and no false clinical route was found. No runtime change is requested. The Engineering verdict does not cover the SSCTR and Quality gates that QE-R7B2-01 makes required under contract §5.

section5.statement: On my evidence the contract §5 condition does NOT hold. One class of changed decision is not 'a nonclinical question replaced by CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED, with no proposal on either side': a return report resent under the event id of a recorded return, with a clinical reason, in a review that also corrects last week's reports. FREEZE-2 returns the report-identity question (or, with a block choice, the block-choice question) carrying the factual re-plan proposal; R7-B.2 returns CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED with no proposal. Once each result is applied, the prescriptions of weeks 5-11 differ. This reopens §5: the SSCTR review becomes required and Quality needs one narrow independent review (contract §5 table, §7 G4).
section5.everyOtherChangedDecision: All other changed decisions found (K6, K6b, CAND-01, CAND-02 without a correction, the 108 substitution rows of the Q1 matrix, the 39 clinical substitution payloads and 83 clinical interruption payloads of the Q4 grid) are ASK with no proposal on FREEZE-2 and CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED with no proposal and pending CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED on R7-B.2.

Impossibility is not claimed. The QE-R7B2-01 shape is expected wherever FREEZE-2 attached a factual re-plan or graduation-withdrawal proposal or disclosure to a question on a clinical review.

Q4.answer: NO new route bypasses the required safety handling, and none was found that returns a false clinical route.
Q4.inventory: Complete for evaluateProgram's decision step. After admission the only exits that can come before a handler's clinical screen are staleReturn (inside decide), factual?.ask (factualReplan and graduationWithdrawal), the block-choice questions and the return's report-identity question; all four now yield to the precedence point. Everything earlier is admission or a safety requirement (integrity/authority/catalog, contract and chronology HOLD; eligibility clinical flag first; eligibility ASK; post-race check; previousValidity incl. sticky clinical first; malformed lists and athlete model; exceptions caught as HOLD). After the decision only the 'could not be applied' question (skips clinical) and proposal validation (clinical proposes nothing) remain. In src/r6-adaptation.mjs only substitutionClinical and interruptionScreen produce CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED after admission; no other handler or callee (r6-composition, r6-program, r7b-repertoire, r6-learning, r6-balanced) does; generateProgram's clinical reject is not imported. KIND_ALIASES maps no alias to EXERCISE_SUBSTITUTION; RETURN maps to RETURN_AFTER_PAUSE and is covered (tested).
Q4.sharedScreens: clinicalRoute calls the same functions on the same review object as the handlers (factual contexts spread ctx; nothing replaces review). q4-screen-fuzz.mjs: 155 substitution payloads (flag spellings incl. objects/arrays/'n'/'nao', 15 free texts, exercise ids string/''/number/null/missing, non-object substitutions) and 133 interruption payloads (13 categories x 8 clinical-flag values, 9 reasons x 3 nonclinical values, non-object interruptions): fresh-state results identical to FREEZE-2 (screens moved verbatim), and in the late-evidence state and the same-id state the result is clinical exactly when the fresh handler result is clinical, with the same reason; otherwise identical to FREEZE-2. 288/288 ok.
Q4.falseRoute: Reviews carrying a clinical substitution that stop before the decision step: 12 not admitted (eligibility missing, 30 days old, non-boolean flag, unknown status; wrong version; not synthetic; asOf outside the week; unknown kind; tampered reference state; observations or choices not a list; malformed athlete model) and 1 taking the eligibility clinical flag's route first: 13/13 identical to FREEZE-2; the point cannot fire before admission. (The 14th row of that grid, a valid reference state pending ASK, is admitted and changes ASK -> CLINICAL as intended.) Witness on an instrumented temporary copy: every precedence route was deep-equal to the review's own handler run directly with a fresh event id (W2 = 0 over 649 routes in the full suite and the judge probes).
Q4.CAND01: Correct. On the hash-valid forged state the factual question with pain or an illness return is CLINICAL with no proposal; without a clinical signal the factual question is asked as before (inventory copy and B.2 tests). QM3 (point after factual?.ask) is killed.
Q4.CAND02: Correct. Same id + illness / INJURY / clinicalReason -> CLINICAL; same id + same facts -> KEEP ('already recorded'); same id + other nonclinical facts -> report-identity question; new id + illness -> CLINICAL; all unchanged where not clinical. QM4 (point limited to substitution) is killed. With a correction in the same review, see QE-R7B2-01.
Q4.M41: The equivalence argument holds. Static: after admission a handler returns CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED only through substitutionClinical or interruptionScreen, which clinicalRoute evaluates on the same review, so handled clinical implies clinical !== null and decision0 is clinical before the guard is read. Empirical: instrumented copy, full suite 799/799 plus the judge probes, 7,555 decision steps, 649 precedence routes, 0 handler-only clinical results (W1 = 0). QM9 (= M41) survives the B.2 and R7-B.1 test files. The guard is dead code on these bytes; it is harmless and does not protect against the K6 class for a future handler (see QE-R7B2-04).
Q4.OBS01: Correctly classified (c), pre-existing (R7-B exerciseSubstitution), outside the QE-R7B1-04 class, and not a safety bypass of clinical-screen-first: no clinical route the handler takes is replaced (its screen is scoped to the named exercise, B0-C06 condition 8 'for the dependent scope') and the review proposes nothing. Unchanged on the frozen bytes. Recorded as QE-R7B2-02 for its residual risk.

findings.title: The precedence point's coverage is not pinned by tests or by structure
findings.origin: Introduced by the B.2 change (the precedence structure; the M41 guard made redundant).
detail: QM7 (the point routes a substitution report without its exercise: 'Pain ... with undefined routes...') survives the whole suite, 799/799; only neighbors-r7b2.mjs's OBS-01 case pins it.
R7-B.1's M41 guard is dead on these bytes (W1 = 0 over 7,555 decision steps) and unkillable (QM9 survives).

The point's completeness rests on clinicalRoute's hand-kept kind list matching the handlers' clinical exits; nothing enforces it. A future handler with its own screen not registered there would silently reopen the QE-R7B1-04 class: the M41 guard would still put its route before the block-choice question but not before staleReturn, factual?.ask or the report-identity question.
